m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT.md, GLOSSARY.md, the rework handoff, NAMING_TABLE.md, AUDIT_MAP.md, and the first-pass result. Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions, return format). Confirm branch feat/physics-units-audit-525 and the 3 target DBs exist. constraints: names are user-approved; do not relitigate
